profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I am a full stack software engineer with a strong background in JavaScript. My experience includes working with technologies such as ReactJS, Angular, and BackboneJS, on the frontend, as well as Node.js on the backend. I have a passion for building data structures and algorithms to solve new and interesting problems. I love to tackle challenging problems together with other talented and creative engineers.

I'm also a massive gearhead and would love to talk cars.

Languages: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3
Frameworks: Angular, Node.js/Express, Backbone.js, D3, React, Ionic
Databases: MongoDB, Sqlite
BDD/TDD: Jasmine, Mocha, Karma
Tools: Twitter Bootstrap, Foundation, Grunt, GitHub, Git, Sublime Text, WordPress, Yeoman, Webpack

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:

●Automated support replies to credit card disputes through integrating Braintree API into Node.js backend.

projects.title: Furry Friends
projects.description:
Platform for individuals to search for adoptable pets in local area, post lost or found pets, and donate for a cause.
● Integrated PetFinder API into JavaScript and Node.js RESTful backend to dynamically update Google Maps components with adoptable pet information for 1000+ shelter locations.
● Wrote 10+ unit tests using Mocha for ReactJS components to ensure 20% less errors during code refactoring.
● Authenticated users using Twitter and Facebook OAuth with JavaScript persisting information in MongoDB.

projects.title: LandMarks
projects.description:
Image analysis system using machine learning to determine name of global landmarks using uploaded photographs.

● Assembled and designed front end views and routing using React and Redux and Google Cloud Vision API.
